soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to loamy soils; pH 5.8–7.0 (neutral to slightly alkaline ideal for N fixation); rich in organic matter; does not tolerate waterlogged soils; loosely tilled to 12–15 inch depth; weed-free seedbed essential as early growth is slow
watering_guideline: Generally not irrigated; annual rainfall 500–1750 mm in growing regions; drought tolerant but severe yield reduction under stress; consistent soil moisture without waterlogging; furrow irrigation preferred over spray to reduce fungal spread; critical stages: flowering (flower abortion under moisture stress) and seed fill; drip or soaker hose recommended if irrigated
basal_fertilizer: FYM or compost 5 t/ha incorporated before planting; N 18–36 kg/ha pre-plant basal (pre-plant N needed even as legume for good nodulation); P 70 kg P2O5/ha for P-deficient soils (split if high P rate); seed inoculation with Rhizobium japonicum specific strain critical; sulphur 20 kg/ha as gypsum for S-deficient soils
top_dressing_1: Fertilize at planting and again 4–6 weeks after emergence; balanced NPK 10:10:10 at 4–6 weeks post-emergence; K 32 lbs/ac (36 kg/ha) K2O as standard rate; P and K applications at young seedling and early flowering stages increase yields on nutrient-poor soils; total N max 36 kg/ha under good inoculation
top_dressing_2: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or 1% KNO3 at 50% flowering for pod set; Mn sulfate 0.9–1.8 kg/ac foliar; ZnSO4 0.22–0.9 kg/ac foliar; borax 0.22–2.7 kg/ac foliar — all as foliar micronutrient applications; no second mineral N top dressing under good nodulation
micronutrients: Mn, Zn, B, Mo are most important micronutrients; Mn sulfate 0.9–1.8 lb/ac foliar; ZnSO4 0.22–0.9 lb/ac; borax 0.22–2.7 lb/ac; molybdenum 500 g/ha seed treatment for N fixation; do not mix Zn foliar with imazethapyr herbicide; gypsum as Ca+S source for pod filling quality
variety_tips: Japanese: Dainagon (large red), Shiroshiro (white); Chinese: Bao-Gan, Zhong-Hong; Asian standard varieties: Erimo, Taiyo; yield 800–1500 kg/ha; duration 80–120 days; plant late spring after soil >13°C; spacing 45–75 cm row × 5–8 cm plant; N fixation up to 100 kg N/ha under good inoculation; rotate once in 3+ years

soil_type: Red lateritic soil with good drainage and high organic matter; pH 5.8–6.2; well-drained; minimum 1.6 m depth; liming required to correct acidity
watering_guideline: Regular watering until establishment; drip irrigation preferred; withhold irrigation during dormancy; elevation 1200–2000 m MSL
basal_fertilizer: FYM 25 kg/tree at planting; N 500 g + P 1000 g + K 1000 g per bearing tree as annual dose
top_dressing_1: Apply full NPK dose (N 500 g, P 1 kg, K 1 kg/tree) during first growth flush (June–July); split into 2–3 applications
top_dressing_2: Post-harvest feeding with FYM 25 kg + balanced NPK to replenish reserves; prune December–January and feed immediately after
micronutrients: Spray lime sulphur 22% SC for scab management; Boron and Zinc foliar sprays during flowering if deficiency noted; liming to maintain pH 5.8–6.2
variety_tips: Low-chilling varieties: Irish Peach (April–May), Carrington/Winterstein (June–July), Rome Beauty/KKL 1 (Aug–Sep); yield 10–20 kg/tree/year from 4th year

soil_type: Well-drained loamy soils; alkaline and saline soils must be avoided; pH 6.0–7.5; garden land, wet land, padugai, or hill banana conditions
watering_guideline: Drip irrigation: 15 L/plant/day (planting–4th month), 20 L/plant/day (5th month–shooting), 25 L/plant/day (shooting–15 days before harvest); wet land: once in 10–15 days; irrigate copiously after every manuring
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10 kg + Neem cake 250 g/pit at planting; Phosphorus full dose (35–90 g P/plant) at 3rd month; biofertilizers: AM 250 g + Azospirillum 50 g + PSB 50 g + Trichoderma 50 g at planting
top_dressing_1: Garden land (non-Nendran): N 110 g + P 35 g + K 330 g/plant/year in 3 splits at 3rd, 5th, 7th MAP; Nendran: N 150 g + P 90 g + K 300 g/plant/year; Wet land: N 210 g + P 35 g + K 450 g/plant/year
top_dressing_2: Fertigation: 200:30:300 g N:P2O5:K2O/plant with 25 L water/day; fertigation schedule—weeks 9–18: N 30%, P 100%, K 20%; weeks 19–30: N 50%, K 40%; weeks 31–42: N 20%, K 32%; weeks 43–45: K 8%
micronutrients: Foliar spray of H3BO3 @ 0.2% at 3rd, 5th, 7th MAP to increase yield and quality; Zinc sulphate 0.5% if deficiency noted; organic: wood ash 1.75 kg/plant for K
variety_tips: Export: Grand Naine, Robusta, Dwarf Cavendish; Tissue culture: apply 50% extra fertilizers at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th MAP; HDP (3 suckers/pit): 2.25× recommended dose/clump; Hill banana: 375 g 40:30:40 NPK + 130 g MOP/clump, 3 times/year

soil_type: Well-drained loamy to sandy loam soil; pH 6.0–7.5; avoid waterlogging; light to medium textured soils preferred
watering_guideline: 3–5 irrigations; critical stages: pre-sowing, branching (20–25 DAS), flowering (35–40 DAS), pod filling (50–55 DAS); 300–450 mm total water requirement
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–12.5 t/ha at last ploughing; N 25 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 25 kg/ha as basal; seed treatment: Rhizobium culture 600 g/ha + Phosphobacteria 600 g/ha
top_dressing_1: N 25 kg/ha top dressing at 30 DAS (branching stage); apply in soil moisture condition
top_dressing_2: No standard top dressing at flowering per research guidelines; foliar spray of 2% DAP at 50% flowering to enhance pod setting and yield
micronutrients: Foliar spray ZnSO4 @ 0.5% + borax 0.1% at flowering; soil application of ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha if deficient; molybdenum 0.5 kg/ha as seed treatment improves N fixation
variety_tips: High-yield varieties: Co 6, VBN 6, KM 2, ADT 3; yield potential 800–1200 kg/ha; duration 65–75 days; kharif and rabi seasons both suitable

soil_type: Well-drained medium to heavy black cotton soil (vertisols) or sandy loam; pH 6.0–8.0; poor drainage leads to root rot; salt-tolerant but not waterlogging
watering_guideline: Largely rainfed; 1–2 supplemental irrigations if needed; critical stage: pre-flowering (35–40 DAS) and pod filling (70–80 DAS); total water 300–400 mm
basal_fertilizer: FYM 5 t/ha; N 20 kg/ha + P 40–60 kg/ha + K 20 kg/ha as basal; seed inoculation with Rhizobium (Mesorhizobium ciceri) 600 g/ha; PSB 600 g/ha
top_dressing_1: N 20 kg/ha top dressing at 30 DAS if nodulation is poor; foliar spray of 2% urea at vegetative stage to boost growth
top_dressing_2: Foliar spray of 2% DAP at flowering stage for improved pod set; K2SO4 1% spray at pod development stage
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha soil application or 0.5% ZnSO4 foliar spray; borax 10 kg/ha for boron-deficient soils; sulphur 20 kg/ha improves protein content
variety_tips: High-yield desi types: JG 11, JAKI 9218, Pusa 256; kabuli types: KAK 2, Pusa 1003; yield 1200–1800 kg/ha; sowing October–November (rabi season)

soil_type: Red sandy loam, laterite, and alluvial soils; heavy imperfectly drained soils unsuitable; withstands waterlogging but prefers well-drained; up to 600 m MSL
watering_guideline: Drip (western, normal): Feb–May: 65 L/day; Jan/Aug/Sep: 55 L/day; Jun–Jul/Oct–Dec: 45 L/day. Basin irrigation: 410 L per 5–9 days depending on season. Year 1: alternate days; Year 2 to maturity: twice a week
basal_fertilizer: At planting: FYM + red earth + sand (equal proportions) in pit; 500 g rock phosphate/pit; biofertilizers: Azospirillum 50 g + Phosphobacteria 50 g + AM fungi 50 g at planting
top_dressing_1: From 5th year: Urea 1.3 kg (560 g N) + Superphosphate 2.0 kg (320 g P2O5) + MOP 2.0 kg (1200 g K2O) + FYM 50 kg per palm per year in 2 equal splits (June–July and December–January). 2nd year: 1/4 dose; 3rd year: 1/2 dose; 4th year: 3/4 dose
top_dressing_2: Fertigation: 75% of recommended dose at monthly intervals via drip; phosphorus as DAP through drip when water quality permits; TNAU coconut tonic 200 mL/palm root-feed twice yearly
micronutrients: TNAU micronutrient mixture @ 1.0 kg/tree/year; ZnSO4 and borax soil application if deficient; foliar spray for iron and manganese if yellowing observed
variety_tips: East Coast Tall, West Coast Tall for general cultivation; VHC 2/VHC 3 hybrids for high yield under managed conditions; COD/ALR 3 dwarfs for tender coconut; intercrop with cocoa, pepper, banana (above 20 years)

soil_type: Deep, friable, open-textured soil rich in humus; slightly acidic (pH 4.5–6.5); light loamy with high organic matter; good drainage essential; elevation: Arabica 1000–1500 m, Robusta 500–1000 m
watering_guideline: Primarily rainfed (Arabica: 1600–2500 mm; Robusta: 1000–2000 mm); sprinkler irrigation March–April for blossom induction; blossom shower Feb–Mar (Robusta) / Mar–Apr (Arabica); backing shower April–May required
basal_fertilizer: Nursery bed: 30–40 kg compost + 2 kg agricultural lime + 400 g rock phosphate per 1×6 m bed; field pit: 500 g rock phosphate per 45×45×45 cm pit; young coffee year 1 (Arabica): 45:30:45 kg N:P2O5:K2O/ha/year
top_dressing_1: Arabica bearing (5+ years, <1 t/ha crop): Pre-blossom (Mar) + Post-blossom (May) + Post-monsoon (Oct) each 40:30:40 kg N:P2O5:K2O/ha = total 140:90:120 kg/ha/year. Robusta (<1 t/ha): 80:60:80 kg/ha/year in 2 splits
top_dressing_2: Arabica (≥1 t/ha crop): 4 splits × 40:30:40 = 160:120:160 kg N:P2O5:K2O/ha/year at pre-blossom, post-blossom, mid-monsoon, post-monsoon. Robusta (≥1 t/ha): 120:90:120 kg/ha in 3 splits
micronutrients: Spray 0.5% Bordeaux mixture at key phenological stages for rust control; Fe, Zn, B foliar applications if deficiency noted; acidic soils may need lime correction
variety_tips: Arabica: SLN 795, Cauvery, Chandragiri (disease resistant); Robusta: SLN 274, SLN 270; spacing: Arabica 1.5–2.0 m, Robusta 2.5 m; intercrop with orange, pepper, banana, pineapple

soil_type: Deep well-drained black cotton soil (vertisols) or red loamy soil; pH 6.0–8.0; medium to heavy texture; avoid saline/alkaline soils; deep tillage required
watering_guideline: Critical irrigations at square formation (45 DAS), flowering (65–70 DAS), boll development (85–95 DAS), and boll opening (110–120 DAS); total 6–8 irrigations; 600–800 mm water requirement; drip irrigation saves 40% water
basal_fertilizer: FYM 12.5 t/ha; N 50 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 50 kg/ha as basal at sowing; biofertilizer: Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + PSB 2 kg/ha with FYM as seed/soil treatment
top_dressing_1: N 50 kg/ha at 30–35 DAS (squaring stage) as urea top dressing; apply after weeding when soil moisture is adequate
top_dressing_2: N 25 kg/ha at boll formation stage (60–70 DAS); K 50 kg/ha as MOP at flowering for improved boll retention and fiber quality; foliar 2% KNO3 at boll development
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha soil application; foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.1% borax at squaring and flowering; iron sulphate 10 kg/ha for iron-deficient soils
variety_tips: Bt hybrids: MRC 7301, RCH 2, Bunny BG II; non-Bt: MCU 5, LRA 5166; yield 1500–2500 kg seed cotton/ha; duration 180–200 days; sow May–June (kharif)

soil_type: Well-drained rich loamy soil; pH 6.5–7.0; EC < 1.0 mS/cm; low water table; minimum 1 m soil depth; Dogridge or 110R rootstocks for high pH/saline conditions
watering_guideline: Drip irrigation: shoot growth (1–40 DAP): 33,600–50,400 L/day/ha; bud differentiation (41–60 DAP): 11,200–14,000 L/day/ha; cane maturity (61–120 DAP): 0–8,400 L/day/ha; berry growth (56–105 DAP): 12,600–25,200 L/day/ha; withhold 15 days before pruning and 15 days before harvest
basal_fertilizer: Trench filling: FYM + sheep manure + green manure + superphosphate 1 month before planting; Muscat Hamburg: FYM 25 kg + SSP 500 g/vine after harvest; Thompson Seedless: FYM 50 kg/vine at Year I
top_dressing_1: Thompson Seedless via fertigation—back pruning: N 80 kg/ha (pre-bud diff, 1–30 DAP); P 213.3 kg/ha (bud differentiation 31–60 DAP); K 80 kg/ha (post-bud diff 61–120 DAP); forward pruning: N 80 kg/ha (pre-bloom 1–40 DAP)
top_dressing_2: Forward pruning: P 106.6 kg/ha (bloom 41–70 DAP); N 80 + K 80 kg/ha (berry growth 71–105 DAP); K 80 kg/ha (veraison–harvest); rest period: N 26.6 + P 35.5 + K 26.6 kg/ha. Muscat Hamburg: N 0.10–0.20 kg + P 0.08–0.16 kg + K 0.30–0.60 kg/vine/year, half K immediately after pruning, rest after 60 days
micronutrients: Foliar spray: 0.2% ZnSO4 + 0.1% boric acid + 0.5% FeSO4 + 0.1% citric acid twice during blooming; soil application: ZnSO4 25 kg + borax 10 kg + FeSO4 50 kg/ha if deficient
variety_tips: Seedless export: Thompson Seedless, Sonaka, Sharad Seedless, Crimson Seedless; table: Red Globe, Muscat Hamburg (Panneer); Muscat Hamburg double pruning for double cropping; total fertigation: N 266.6 + P 355.2 + K 266.6 kg/ha/season

soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam or sandy clay loam soils; pH 6.5–7.0; deep, loose, friable soils for pod development; red soils preferred; avoid heavy clay and waterlogged soils; light to medium texture ensures good pegging and pod filling
watering_guideline: 4–5 irrigations; critical stages: pegging (30–40 DAS), flowering (40–50 DAS), pod development (60–80 DAS), pod filling (80–100 DAS); total 450–600 mm; avoid excess moisture; rainfed in kharif, irrigated in rabi and rice fallows; pre-sowing irrigation for good germination
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–12 t/ha once in 2–3 seasons; N 20 kg/ha + P 40 kg P2O5/ha + K 60 kg K2O/ha as basal for kharif; P through SSP (contains S); gypsum 250 kg/ha at flowering for pod filling and Ca supply; Rhizobium inoculation 600 g/ha; no N if good nodulation at 30 DAS
top_dressing_1: N 20–30 kg/ha top dressing at 30–35 DAS if nodulation is poor; ammonium sulphate preferred (provides 24% S); apply at good soil moisture; gypsum 250 kg/ha at pegging stage for calcium-mediated pod filling; PSB 600 g/ha seed treatment
top_dressing_2: No standard second mineral top dressing; foliar spray: 1% KNO3 or 2% KCl at pod development; MnSO4 0.1% + CuSO4 0.05% + ZnSO4 0.5% foliar at flowering and pod filling for improved yield and quality; Fe chelate 1% if iron chlorosis in alkaline soils
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha once in 3 seasons; gypsum 250 kg/ha for Ca+S; boron 1 kg/ha foliar at flowering; MnSO4 1–2 kg/ha foliar; CuSO4 0.5–1 kg/ha foliar; ammonium sulphate as N source provides critical S; avoid lime excess which blocks micronutrient uptake
variety_tips: Kharif bunchy: TMV 2, ICGS 44, Kadiri 7 Bold; spreading: ICGV 91114, Greeshma; rabi/summer irrigated: Co 2, Co 3, TG 26; yield 1500–2500 kg/ha rainfed, 2500–4000 kg/ha irrigated; seed rate 32–40 kg/ha bunchy, 24–32 kg/ha spreading; spacing 30×15 cm (bunchy), 45×15 cm (spreading)

soil_type: Sandy loam to clay loam alluvial soil; pH 6.0–7.5; well-drained with high moisture retention; river basins and deltaic soils ideal; avoid waterlogging during early growth
watering_guideline: Rainfed crop; requires 1500–2000 mm well-distributed rainfall; supplemental irrigation at germination and early vegetative stage if dry spell; no irrigation after 40 DAS normally
basal_fertilizer: FYM 5 t/ha or compost 2.5 t/ha incorporated before sowing; N 20 kg/ha + P 20 kg/ha + K 20 kg/ha as basal at sowing
top_dressing_1: N 40 kg/ha top dressing at 30 DAS (15–20 cm plant height); apply in moist soil; total N: 60 kg/ha
top_dressing_2: No standard second top dressing; foliar spray of 1% KNO3 at 45–50 DAS for stem quality and fiber strength; K 20 kg/ha additional if soils are potassium-deficient
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20 kg/ha soil application; borax 5 kg/ha for boron supplementation; foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO4 at 30 DAS for improved fiber quality
variety_tips: Corchorus olitorius (tossa): JRO-524, JRO-8432; Corchorus capsularis (white): JRC-321, JRC-212; yield 2.5–3.5 t/ha fiber; sow March–May; harvest 90–120 DAS when 50% plants in flower bud stage

soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to loam soil; pH 6.0–7.5; high organic matter; avoid heavy clay and waterlogged soils; light-textured, friable soils preferred for root development
watering_guideline: Critical irrigations: pre-sowing, 20–25 DAS (branching), 35–40 DAS (flowering), 50–55 DAS (pod filling); 4–6 irrigations total; 450–600 mm total water; avoid excess moisture
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–12 t/ha; N 20 kg/ha + P 60 kg/ha + K 40 kg/ha as basal; seed treatment: Rhizobium phaseoli 600 g/ha + PSB 600 g/ha with rice gruel binder
top_dressing_1: N 20 kg/ha at 30 DAS (first branching/vegetative stage); apply in furrows and irrigate; total N: 40 kg/ha
top_dressing_2: Foliar spray 2% DAP at flowering (40–45 DAS) for improved pod set; K 20 kg/ha as MOP at pod filling stage if needed
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20–25 kg/ha soil application; boron 1 kg/ha as borax foliar at flowering; molybdenum 500 g/ha seed treatment to improve N fixation
variety_tips: Varieties: Arka Komal, Contender, Pusa Parvati; yield 1200–1500 kg/ha (dry) or 8–10 t/ha (green pods); sow October–November (rabi) or June–July (kharif); duration 90–110 days

soil_type: Well-drained loamy to sandy loam soil; pH 6.0–8.0; fertile soils with moderate moisture retention; tolerates moderately alkaline and slightly saline conditions; avoid waterlogging
watering_guideline: Mainly rainfed; 1–2 supplemental irrigations; pre-sowing irrigation critical; pod-filling stage (60–70 DAS) if dry; total water 250–350 mm; drought-tolerant but sensitive to excess moisture
basal_fertilizer: FYM 5 t/ha; N 20 kg/ha + P 40 kg/ha + K 20 kg/ha as basal at sowing; Rhizobium (lentil-specific) 600 g/ha seed inoculation + PSB 600 g/ha
top_dressing_1: If nodulation poor: N 20 kg/ha top dressing at 25–30 DAS; foliar urea 1% at branching stage if growth is slow
top_dressing_2: Foliar spray 2% DAP at 50% flowering for pod set improvement; no standard second mineral top dressing under normal nodulation
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20 kg/ha; molybdenum 500 g/ha as seed treatment; sulphur 20 kg/ha for improved protein content; boron 1 kg/ha as foliar at flowering
variety_tips: Varieties: DPL 15, WBL 77, IPL 406, PL 8; yield 1000–1500 kg/ha; duration 110–130 days; sow October–November (rabi); intercrop with mustard or wheat in rainfed areas

soil_type: All maize-growing soils with pH 6.0–7.0; well-drained loamy soils preferred; light sandy to heavy clay soils possible; good tilth required; temperature 18–32°C
watering_guideline: Spacing: irrigated 60×25 cm, rainfed 45×20 cm; 6–8 irrigations for irrigated maize; critical stages: knee-high (25–30 DAS), tasseling/silking (50–55 DAS), grain filling (70–80 DAS); 500–700 mm total water
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–15 t/ha; N 50 kg/ha + P 50–75 kg/ha + K 50 kg/ha as basal at sowing; seed treatment: Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + PSB 2 kg/ha
top_dressing_1: N 50 kg/ha at knee-high stage (25–30 DAS); apply as band placement alongside rows; total N: 100–120 kg/ha for irrigated maize
top_dressing_2: N 25 kg/ha at tasseling stage (50–55 DAS) if recommended dose not fully applied; K 25 kg/ha supplementation at grain filling for improved grain weight
micronutrients: Foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO4 at 45 DAS and 10 days after for each spray; soil application ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha; Fe-deficient soils: FeSO4 10 kg/ha + 0.1% citric acid foliar
variety_tips: Hybrids: HQPM 1 (QPM), 900 M Gold, DK 9108; composites: Vikram, Amber; yield 5–8 t/ha irrigated; duration 90–110 days; baby corn: VL 78, HM 4; rogue spacing 75 cm every 10 rows

soil_type: Red loamy soil with good drainage; pH 6.5–8.0; UHDP in normal soil also suitable; avoid heavy clay and waterlogged soils; pit size 1×1×1 m
watering_guideline: Regular watering until establishment; drip irrigation preferred; avoid irrigation 30 days before flowering (stress induction); resume at flowering; drip schedule based on weekly fertigation intervals
basal_fertilizer: Conventional: FYM 10 kg/tree Year 1, increasing to 50 kg from 6th year; N 0.2 kg/tree Year 1 rising to 1.0 kg; P 0.2 kg rising to 1.0 kg; K 0.3 kg rising to 1.5 kg/tree/year. UHDP Year 1: N 35 g + P 15 g + K 25 g + FYM 5 kg/tree
top_dressing_1: HDP fertigation: Apply 1.0:0.5:1.0 kg NPK/bearing tree/year; after-harvest split (2 months, 25% N/K); pre-flowering split (2 months, 40% N); UHDP 4th year onwards: N 120 g + P 75 g + K 100 g + FYM 15 kg/tree
top_dressing_2: Flowering to fruit set (2 months): 20% N, 20% P, 25% K; fruit development (4 months): 15% N, 30% K; fertigation at weekly intervals minimum 6 doses per stage
micronutrients: Spray Zinc sulphate 0.5% (500 g/100 L) thrice at 10-day intervals from 40 DAS; MgSO4 via fertigation (0.278–0.833 kg/dose/acre per UHDP schedule); 8% plant wax (Fruitox/Waxol) pre-harvest to reduce anthracnose
variety_tips: Export: Alphonso, Banganapalli, Sendura; processing: Alphonso, Banganapalli, Totapuri; high-yield hybrids: Mallika, Amrapali, Arka Anmol, Arka Aruna; UHDP at 3×2 m (1666 plants/ha); HDP at 5×5 m (400 plants/ha)

soil_type: Well-drained sandy to loamy soils; pH 6.0–7.5; light soils of low inherent fertility with mild salinity acceptable; does not tolerate waterlogged acidic soils; tolerates drought but not high rainfall (>90 cm); fine seedbed tilth required as seeds are tiny
watering_guideline: Primarily rainfed requiring 40–50 cm annual rainfall; 3 supplemental irrigations for panicle initiation, flag leaf, and flowering under limited water; skip top dressing N under prolonged dry spell and apply 2% urea foliar instead; drip or sprinkler recommended; additional 20 kg N/ha if excessive rain during vegetative phase
basal_fertilizer: FYM or compost 10–15 t/ha applied 20 days before sowing for full decomposition; 1/2 N + full P + full K as basal 3–5 cm below seed at sowing; hybrid recommended dose: N 80–100 kg/ha + P 40–50 kg/ha + K 40–50 kg/ha; Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + PSB 2 kg/ha seed treatment
top_dressing_1: 1/4 N at 30 DAS (knee-high/vegetative stage); 1/4 N at 60 DAS (panicle initiation); do not place fertilizer in furrow with seeds to avoid germination burn; foliar 3% urea under rainfed/barani conditions if dry spell occurs
top_dressing_2: Final N application complete by panicle initiation; no top dressing after heading; under excessive rainfall add extra N 20 kg/ha at vegetative phase; K supplementation if deficiency (leaf margin scorch, dark red leaves, leathery texture); foliar MnSO4 if micronutrient deficiency symptoms appear
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 10 kg/ha soil application in Zn-deficient soils; 0.2% ZnSO4 foliar at tillering to pre-flowering for correction; iron deficiency: FeSO4 foliar at early stage; sulphur 10–15 kg/ha in S-deficient coastal soils; MnSO4 and MgSO4 foliar if yellowing observed
variety_tips: Hybrids: RHB 138, HHB 67 (Haryana), ICTP 8203, CO (B) 6 (TN); composites: WCC 75, Raj 171; yield 1500–3000 kg/ha rainfed, 3000–4500 kg/ha irrigated; kharif sowing July (north India), Oct–Nov (Tamil Nadu rabi), Feb–May (summer irrigated); duration 60–90 days

soil_type: Well-drained sandy to sandy loam soil; pH 6.0–8.0; drought-tolerant; grows well in arid and semi-arid soils; low fertility soils tolerated; avoid heavy clay and waterlogging
watering_guideline: Highly drought-tolerant; 2–3 supplemental irrigations if needed; pre-sowing moisture important; pod-filling stage (50–60 DAS) is critical; total water 200–300 mm; rain-fed cultivation common
basal_fertilizer: FYM 5 t/ha; N 20 kg/ha + P 40 kg/ha + K 20 kg/ha as basal; seed inoculation with Rhizobium (cowpea type) 600 g/ha; minimal nutrient input due to soil N fixation
top_dressing_1: N 20 kg/ha top dressing at 25–30 DAS if growth is slow; apply in soil moisture; total N: 40 kg/ha maximum
top_dressing_2: Foliar 2% DAP at flowering stage; no standard second mineral top dressing; K 20 kg/ha as MOP if pod retention is poor
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20 kg/ha soil; borax 5 kg/ha; molybdenum 500 g/ha as seed treatment; sulphur 10 kg/ha for protein quality
variety_tips: Varieties: RMO 40, RMO 225, CAZRI Moth 1, Jadia; yield 500–800 kg/ha rainfed; 1000–1200 kg/ha under irrigation; duration 70–90 days; summer and kharif sowing; intercrop with pearl millet

soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to loam soil; pH 6.0–7.5; light to medium texture preferred; high organic matter beneficial; avoid waterlogging and saline conditions
watering_guideline: 4–6 irrigations; critical stages: germination (0–10 DAS), branching (25–30 DAS), flowering (35–40 DAS), pod filling (50–55 DAS); 350–450 mm total water
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10 t/ha; N 25 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 25 kg/ha as basal; Rhizobium (mungbean-specific) 600 g/ha + Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + PSB 2 kg/ha seed treatment
top_dressing_1: N 25 kg/ha at 30 DAS (branching stage); apply in moist soil; total N: 50 kg/ha; avoid excess N which promotes vegetative growth at expense of pods
top_dressing_2: Foliar 2% DAP at 50% flowering; K 25 kg/ha MOP at pod filling if deficiency observed; no standard second mineral top dressing under normal conditions
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha soil; 0.5% ZnSO4 foliar at flowering; borax 0.1% foliar at flowering; molybdenum 500 g/ha seed treatment for N fixation
variety_tips: Varieties: Co 6, VBN 2, KM 2, Pusa Vishal, SML 668; yield 800–1200 kg/ha; duration 60–70 days; summer (Feb–Mar) and kharif (Jun–Jul) seasons; two crops per year possible

soil_type: Sandy loam rich in organic matter with good drainage; pH 6.5–7.5; form long channels 2.5 m apart; raised bed system (1.2 m width, 30 cm height) preferred
watering_guideline: Irrigate before sowing then once a week; drip system: inline laterals at 1.5 m interval, drippers at 60 cm (4 LPH) and 50 cm (3.5 LPH); raised bed drip system recommended
basal_fertilizer: FYM 20 t/ha; NPK 40:60:30 kg/ha as basal; Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + Phosphobacteria 2 kg/ha + Pseudomonas 2.5 kg/ha with FYM 50 kg/ha + neem cake 100 kg/ha before last ploughing; 75% of P (469 kg/ha superphosphate) as basal
top_dressing_1: N 40 kg/ha top dressing at 30 DAS; fertigation—vegetative stage (30 days): N 60.19 + P 7.49 + K 29.7 kg/ha via 12-61-0, 13-0-45, Urea split; establishment phase (10 days): N 19.78 + P 5.00 + K 9.95 kg/ha
top_dressing_2: Fertigation—flower initiation to first picking (30 days): N 60.09 + P 7.49 + K 19.8 kg/ha; harvesting stage (45 days): N 60.00 + P 5.00 + K 40.1 kg/ha; total fertigation dose: 200:100:100 kg NPK/ha
micronutrients: 19:19:19 + micronutrient grade fertilizer at establishment (26.81 kg/ha) and harvest stage (26.31 kg/ha); ZnSO4 0.5% foliar if deficiency noted; neem cake 100 kg/ha pre-plant for soil health
variety_tips: Varieties: Pusa Sharbati, Hara Madhu, Durgapura Madhu, Arka Rajhans, Arka Jeet; yield 20 t/ha in 120 days; sow November–February; spacing 1.5 m × 30 cm in raised bed single-row system

soil_type: Deep well-drained loamy soils; pH 6.5–7.5; EC of water < 1.0 mS/cm; dry climate with 50–75 cm rainfall June–September; avoid waterlogging near trunk
watering_guideline: Irrigate copiously at planting; once in 10 days regular irrigation; continuous during fruit development; avoid water near trunk (double ring or check bund method); stop 1–2 months before flowering; drip irrigation advisable
basal_fertilizer: At planting: FYM 10 kg + topsoil in 75×75×75 cm pit; Year 1: FYM 10 kg + N 200 g + P 100 g + K 100 g/plant; apply P and K in October; N in 2 doses March and October
top_dressing_1: Annual increase: FYM +5 kg + N +100 g + P +20 g + K +40 g/plant/year; from 6th year: FYM 30 kg + N 600 g + P 200 g + K 300 g/plant/year; apply in basin 70 cm from trunk
top_dressing_2: Foliar spray containing ZnSO4 0.5% + Mn 0.05% + Fe 0.25% + Mg 0.5% + Boron 0.1% + Mo 0.003% once in 3 months at new flush; soil: 50 g each Zn, Mn, Fe per tree per year
micronutrients: ZnSO4 0.5%, MnSO4 0.05%, FeSO4 0.25%, MgSO4 0.5%, H3BO3 0.1%, (NH4)6Mo7O24 0.003% foliar spray quarterly; soil application 50 g each ZnSO4, MnSO4, FeSO4 per tree per year
variety_tips: Sweet orange: Sathugudi, Batavian, Mosambi, Malta blood red, Cutter Valencia; yield 30 t/ha; bearing from 5th year; fruit matures in 9–12 months; Mandarin: Coorg Orange, Kodai Orange for hill areas (500–1500 m MSL)

soil_type: Well-drained soils of uniform texture; avoid poor drainage (causes collar rot); pH 6.0–7.0; tropical conditions; elevation up to 1200 m; pit size 45×45×45 cm
watering_guideline: Irrigate copiously after planting then once a week; fertigation: 10 L/plant/day + 13.5 g urea + 10.5 g MOP/week via drip; soil application of superphosphate 300 g/plant every 2 months from 3–4 MAP
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10 kg/plant as basal at planting; biofertilizers: AM fungi 50 g + PSB 25 g + Azospirillum 50 g + Trichoderma harzianum 50 g at planting; re-apply Azospirillum 20 g + PSB 20 g at 6 MAP
top_dressing_1: N 50 g + P 50 g + K 50 g/plant every 2 months from 3rd month after planting (after removing excess sex forms); continue at bi-monthly intervals throughout crop duration
top_dressing_2: Fertigation: 13.5 g urea/week (equivalent to ~6.2 g N/week) + 10.5 g MOP/week; SSP 300 g/plant at bi-monthly soil application from 3–4 MAP; re-apply Azospirillum 20 g + PSB 20 g at 6 MAP
micronutrients: Spray 0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.1% H3BO3 at 4th and 8th MAP to improve growth and yield; ZnSO4 0.5% + Boron 0.1% at 4th and 7th MAP for vector management integration
variety_tips: CO 8 (TNAU, dual-purpose): 220–230 t/ha; CO 7 (gynodioecious): 200–225 t/ha; CO 5 (table+papain): 200–250 t/ha; CO 3 (table): 100–120 t/ha; Red Lady (commercial); crop duration 24–30 months; sow June–September

soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to loamy soils; pH 6.0–7.5; light to medium texture; high organic matter improves yield; avoid heavy clay and waterlogged soils; cool-season crop; shallow root system; weed-free seedbed critical
watering_guideline: Weekly deep soaking at root level; critical stages: flowering and pod filling — keep soil consistently moist; shallow roots require monitoring (4–5 inch depth); use soaker hoses or mist sprayer at low pressure to avoid soil erosion; avoid waterlogging; 300–400 mm total; mulching conserves moisture and reduces watering frequency
basal_fertilizer: Compost or well-rotted FYM 10 t/ha incorporated before planting; N 20 kg/ha + P 60 kg/ha + K 40 kg/ha as basal; Rhizobium leguminosarum inoculation 600 g/ha seed treatment; light starter liquid fertilizer (all-purpose balanced) at seedling emergence; P and K applied entirely as basal
top_dressing_1: Light balanced liquid fertilizer at 2-inch seedling height; foliar spray of 2% DAP at 50% flowering for pod set; N top dressing only needed if nodulation is visually poor (20 kg/ha at 30 DAS); avoid excess N which promotes vine/leaf growth at expense of pods
top_dressing_2: No standard second mineral top dressing; K 20 kg/ha MOP at pod filling if soil test indicates deficiency; single fertilization approach for most field conditions; organic peas: vermicompost or well-rotted manure worked into soil is sufficient without chemical top dressing
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20 kg/ha; borax 5–10 kg/ha for boron; molybdenum 500 g/ha as seed treatment (critical for N fixation in peas); Mn foliar 0.1% if chlorosis; sulphur 10 kg/ha as gypsum improves protein content; micronutrient foliar at flowering stage for quality improvement
variety_tips: Bush types: Arkel, Bonneville, Meteor; climbing: Pusa Pragati, Pusa Snowball; yield 4–8 t/ha green pods; duration 60–90 days; cool-season crop sow Oct–Dec (India plains), Mar–Apr (hills); spacing 25×5 cm; support/stake for climbing varieties; harvest when seeds just outlined in pod

soil_type: Well-drained deep loam to clay loam soil; pH 6.0–8.0; tolerates moderately alkaline soils; medium black soils in kharif; avoid waterlogging; deep rooted so 60+ cm depth ideal
watering_guideline: Mainly rainfed; 2–3 supplemental irrigations; critical: flowering (75–80 DAS) and pod filling (100–110 DAS); total 400–500 mm; medium-duration 120–180 days, long-duration 240–280 days
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10 t/ha; N 20 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 30 kg/ha as basal; Rhizobium (pigeonpea-specific) 600 g/ha + PSB 600 g/ha seed treatment; very low N input due to nodulation
top_dressing_1: N 20 kg/ha at 30–35 DAS only if nodulation is visually poor; foliar spray 2% urea at 45 DAS for vegetative vigor; total N max 40 kg/ha under good nodulation
top_dressing_2: Foliar 2% DAP at 50% flowering for pod set; K 20 kg/ha MOP at early pod stage; MnSO4 0.1% foliar for pod quality improvement
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha soil; borax 10 kg/ha; 0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.1% borax foliar at flowering; molybdenum 500 g/ha seed treatment; sulphur 20 kg/ha for dhal quality
variety_tips: Short-duration (120–130 days): ICPL 87119, PPE 46-2; medium: ICPL 151, CO 6; long-duration: CO 5, BDN 2; yield 1200–1600 kg/ha; sow June–July (kharif); intercrop with sorghum, groundnut, or cotton at 1:4 ratio

soil_type: Wide range of soils; drought-resistant and tolerant to salinity and alkalinity; cool winter and dry summer required; grows up to 1800 m elevation; pit size 60×60×60 cm
watering_guideline: Copious irrigation essential during fruiting season; withhold irrigation 2 months prior to bahar treatment; in sandy/shallow soils withhold 4–5 weeks; resume irrigation after pruning for profuse flowering; regular irrigation throughout rest of season
basal_fertilizer: Year 1: FYM 10 kg + N 0.20 kg + P 0.10 kg + K 0.40 kg/plant; pit filling with FYM and soil mixture at planting; biofertilizer: Pseudomonas fluorescens or Trichoderma at planting
top_dressing_1: Years 2–5: FYM 20 kg + N 0.40 kg + P 0.25 kg + K 0.80 kg/plant/year; apply immediately after pruning during bahar treatment; split into 2 doses if needed
top_dressing_2: Year 6+: FYM 30 kg + N 0.60 kg + P 0.50 kg + K 1.20 kg/plant/year; spray 2% KNO3 thrice at monthly intervals during and after flowering season; ethrel 2–2.5 mL/L + DAP 5 g/L at bahar initiation
micronutrients: Apply micronutrients based on soil test; ZnSO4 soil application for Zn deficiency; foliar spray of Boron and Zinc if leaf symptoms appear; Mn and Fe applications in alkaline soils
variety_tips: Bhagwa, Ganesh, Arakta, Jyothi (general); bacterial blight tolerant: Nayana, Kalpitiya, Nana; Hasta bahar (June–July flower, March–April harvest) gives best fruit color and fetches highest market price; preferred for export

soil_type: Clay to clay loam soils with good water retention; pH 5.5–7.0; puddled soil for transplanted rice; well-leveled fields; alluvial soils ideal; poor drainage or standing water tolerated
watering_guideline: Transplanted: standing water 2–5 cm throughout vegetative stage; drain 7–10 days before harvest; SRI method: alternate wetting and drying (AWD) — irrigate when soil cracks appear; total 1200–2000 mm; critical: tillering (20–30 DAT) and panicle initiation (45–50 DAT)
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–12.5 t/ha incorporated at puddling; N 50 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 50 kg/ha as basal at transplanting; Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + PSB 2 kg/ha with FYM seed/soil treatment; 40 g Azospirillum seed treatment per kg of seed
top_dressing_1: N 50 kg/ha at active tillering stage (20–25 DAT); apply in standing water for uniform distribution; reduce to 25 kg/ha under Azospirillum use
top_dressing_2: N 25 kg/ha at panicle initiation stage (45–50 DAT); K 25 kg/ha if potassium deficiency observed at panicle initiation; 2% KNO3 foliar at grain filling for improved milling quality
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha at basal or foliar 0.5% ZnSO4 at 40 and 50 DAS; Fe: FeSO4 10 kg/ha + citric acid 2.5 kg/ha foliar for iron chlorosis; Si: silica slag 500–1000 kg/ha for blast resistance
variety_tips: High-yielding: CO 51, ADT 45, IR 64, Swarna; aromatic: Basmati 370; hybrid: KRH 2, DRRH 3; yield 5–7 t/ha transplanted, 4–5 t/ha direct sown; SRI method: 8–10 t/ha; duration 105–150 days depending on variety

soil_type: Deep, fertile, laterite or loamy soil with pH 4.5–6.0; well-drained with no waterlogging; elevation 300–800 m MSL; tropical climate 20–34°C; annual rainfall 2000–5000 mm; sloping or undulating land suitable with drainage; 450–500 plants/ha at 7×3 m spacing
watering_guideline: Primarily rainfed requiring 2000–4500 mm well-distributed rainfall; 125 mm/month minimum for optimum gaseous exchange; summer irrigation: 50% ETc via basin irrigation (superior to drip in subhumid zones); young plants (years 1–3): basin irrigation every 7–10 days in summer; drip or sprinkler for nursery; growth 2.8× higher under irrigation in subhumid tracts
basal_fertilizer: Basal at planting: FYM 2.5 t/ha + rock phosphate 350 kg/ha in pit; pit filled with topsoil + compost; 3 months after planting: 10:10:4:1.5 NPK+Mg mixture @ 225 g/plant (100 kg/ha); leguminous cover crops (Pueraria, Calopagonium, Centrosema) for soil nitrogen and conservation
top_dressing_1: Immature rubber schedule (10:10:4:1.5 NPK+Mg mixture): 3 MAP: 225 g/plant, 9 MAP: 445 g/plant, 15 MAP: 450 g/plant (200 kg/ha), 21 MAP: 450 g (250 kg/ha), 27 MAP: 550 g (250 kg/ha), 33 MAP: 550 g (200 kg/ha), 39 MAP: 450 g (200 kg/ha); apply in April/May and September/October cycles
top_dressing_2: From 5th year to tapping age: 400 kg mixture/ha in 2 doses (April/May + September/October); matured tapping trees: NPK 10:10:10 mixture 900 g/tree (300 kg/ha) per year in 2 splits; MgSO4 10 kg per 100 kg mixture if Mg deficiency observed; biofertilizers: Azospirillum + PSB 50 g each at planting
micronutrients: MgSO4 supplement at 10 kg per 100 kg NPK if deficiency (orange-yellow interveinal chlorosis); B and Zn foliar if leaf symptoms; avoid copper fungicides (contaminates latex); lime/dolomite for pH correction if below 4.5; FYM and green manure crop incorporation annually
variety_tips: High yield RRII clones: RRII 430, RRII 429, RRII 105, RRII 417, RRII 422; RRIM 600 (latex physiology); PB 260, PB 217 (international high yield); tapping ready at 7–8 years (50 cm girth); yield 1500–2000 kg dry rubber/ha/year; RRIM 600 widely grown; cover crops: Pueraria phaseoloides, Desmodium ovalifolium

soil_type: Medium to heavy textured soils; pH 5.0–8.5; deep, well-drained fertile soils preferred; high water retention capacity; avoid highly saline soils; black cotton soil and alluvial soils also suitable
watering_guideline: Highly irrigated crop; 8–10 irrigations for plant cane; critical stages: germination (0–30 DAP), tillering (30–90 DAP), grand growth phase (90–210 DAP); furrow widened to 45 cm at 45 DAP and deepened at 90 DAP; total water 1500–2000 mm; drip irrigation can save 35% water
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–12.5 t/ha incorporated before planting; rock phosphate 350 kg/ha (or SSP 625 kg/ha) in furrow at planting; biofertilizers: Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus 2 kg/ha as sett treatment; basal P applied within 30–45 days of planting
top_dressing_1: N and K in 4 splits: 1st at 30–45 DAP, 2nd at 60–75 DAP, 3rd at 90–105 DAP, 4th at 120–135 DAP; blanket dose: N 275 kg/ha + K 112.5 kg/ha total; urea mixed with neem cake (4:1) to reduce volatilization; apply in 10 cm holes at 15 cm spacing around rows
top_dressing_2: Final N top dressing at 120–135 DAP; complete all N application minimum 5 months before harvest; ratoon crop: N 345 kg/ha + K 140 kg/ha in 4 splits; micronutrient mixture 50 kg/ha (FeSO4 20 kg + ZnSO4 10 kg + MnSO4 10 kg + CuSO4 5 kg + borax 5 kg/ha); fertigation up to 210 DAP recommended
micronutrients: Micronutrient mixture 50 kg/ha: FeSO4 20 kg + ZnSO4 10 kg + MnSO4 10 kg + CuSO4 5 kg + borax 5 kg/ha; ferrous sulphate foliar 2.5 kg/ha at 15 DAP if chlorosis; CuSO4 0.2% foliar twice if copper deficiency; silicon and sulphur beneficial for juice quality
variety_tips: Co-86032, Co-671, Co-7201 (early); CoC 671, Co-62175 (mid-late); TNAU main season Dec–May, special season Jun–Sep; expected yield 200–300 t/ha; harvest after 11 months; 1 kg N per tonne expected cane for plant crop, 1.25–1.5 kg N/tonne for ratoon

soil_type: Lateritic, alluvial, or peaty soils; strongly acidic pH 4.5–6.0 (optimum 4.8–5.0); well-drained with high organic matter content; South Indian hills 600–2200 m MSL; low calcium content preferred; slope soils with bench terracing
watering_guideline: Drip irrigation: 2 mm/day in Nilgiris/Central Travancore with NK fertigation in 10 splits; sprinkler: 6.25 cm/ha every 20 days in Wayanad and Karnataka; rainfall requirement 125–150 cm well distributed over 8–9 months; subsoil irrigation via mud tubes (1 L/plant/week) during dry spells; maintain 80% relative humidity
basal_fertilizer: Mulching with 25 t/ha of Guatemala grass immediately after planting; rock phosphate 30 kg P2O5/ha/yr (below 3500 kg/ha yield) or 40 kg P2O5/ha/yr (above 3500 kg/ha) in two 6-month splits with 300–500 g citric acid per split; dolomitic lime periodically to maintain pH 4.8
top_dressing_1: Plucking field NK ratio 1:1; pruned field 2:3 NK; rejuvenation pruned field 1:2 NK; N application: 150–300 kg N/ha/yr in 4–6 splits at minimum 3–4 week intervals; all NK applied by broadcast; MOP is potassium source; fertilizer placed 15–22 cm depth for young tea along drip circle
top_dressing_2: Phosphorus applied once in alternate years: 90 kg P2O5/ha for <3000 kg/ha yield; 60–80 kg P2O5/ha annually for 3000–4500 kg/ha yield; K2O 40–60 kg/ha; fertigation with NK 1:1 in drip system in 10 splits showed yield enhancement; foliar spray of NPK + Mg + micronutrients (Mangala Bio 20) at each round
micronutrients: ZnSO4 8–12 kg/ha/yr as foliar in 4–6 rounds: 1% ZnSO4 in 200 L water + MnSO4 500 ppm + boric acid 100 ppm + NAA 10 ppm per round; dolomitic lime for Ca and Mg; MgSO4 if K:Mg antagonism; Cu sulphate 10–20 kg/ha soil or 1% chelate foliar if deficient
variety_tips: UPASI clones: BSS 1-5, Athrey, Evergreen; Tamil Nadu: Pandian, Sundaram, Golconda, Jayaram; Assam: TV-26, TV-29; yield 3000–5000 kg made tea/ha under good management; harvest by two-leaves-and-a-bud plucking; plucking rounds every 7–12 days

soil_type: Light sandy loam to medium loam soils; pH 5.5–6.5; well-drained, low clay content preferred for cured leaf quality; red sandy loams for flue-cured; black soils for bidi tobacco; avoid heavy waterlogged soils; moderate fertility — over-rich soils reduce quality
watering_guideline: 6–8 irrigations; critical stages: transplanting (immediate), establishment (0–20 DAT), rapid growth (30–50 DAT), leaf development (50–70 DAT); avoid irrigation 2–3 weeks before harvest for quality curing; total 500–600 mm; drip irrigation improves quality and reduces disease; furrow irrigation common
basal_fertilizer: FYM 10–15 t/ha incorporated 3–4 weeks before transplanting; N 60–80 kg/ha + P 60–80 kg/ha + K 120–150 kg/ha as basal; entire P and K as basal; K is critical for leaf quality and combustibility — use potassium sulphate (not MOP/KCl which increases Cl affecting combustion quality)
top_dressing_1: N split: 50–60% as basal, 40–50% top dressing at 3–4 weeks after transplanting (active growth); apply N close to plants in band; avoid N after rapid growth phase as it reduces nicotine and leaf quality; total N 60–100 kg/ha depending on type (flue-cured lower, dark air-cured higher)
top_dressing_2: Final N at 4–5 weeks after transplanting if growth slow; K top dressing (K2SO4 25–30 kg/ha) at leaf development stage; avoid MOP/KCl entirely for quality tobacco; no N after topping (flower removal) which is done at 50–60 cm height to concentrate leaf growth; potassium deficiency shows as mottled chlorosis
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 20 kg/ha soil application; boron 1–2 kg/ha (critical for cell wall and leaf quality); Mn foliar 0.1% if chlorosis; Mg deficiency common — MgSO4 25 kg/ha soil or 1% foliar; avoid chloride-based fertilizers as Cl reduces combustibility of cured leaf; sulphur from K2SO4 is beneficial
variety_tips: Flue-cured Virginia: Kanakaprabha, NCTB 1, K-326; bidi: Diksam, Bhavani; dark air-cured: GG 4, VRI 2; yield: FCV 1500–2200 kg/ha, dark air-cured 1200–1800 kg/ha; sow Sept–Oct in nursery, transplant Nov–Dec; duration 90–110 days from transplanting; topping at 50–60 cm height is critical management practice

soil_type: Sandy loam rich in organic matter with good drainage; pH 6.5–7.5; form long channels 2.5 m apart; raised beds 1.2 m width × 30 cm height for drip cultivation
watering_guideline: Irrigate before sowing then once a week; drip system: inline laterals at 1.5 m, drippers at 60 cm (4 LPH) and 50 cm (3.5 LPH); irrigate beds 8–12 hrs continuously before planting; spray Ethrel 250 ppm (2.5 mL/10 L) 4 times at weekly intervals from 15 DAS
basal_fertilizer: FYM 20 t/ha; P 55 kg/ha + K 55 kg/ha as basal; Azospirillum 2 kg/ha + Phosphobacteria 2 kg/ha + Pseudomonas 2.5 kg/ha with FYM 50 kg/ha + neem cake 100 kg/ha before last ploughing; 75% of P (469 kg/ha superphosphate) as basal
top_dressing_1: N 55 kg/ha at 30 DAS; fertigation—vegetative stage (30 days): N 60.19 + P 7.49 + K 29.7 kg/ha via 12-61-0 (12.28 kg/ha), 13-0-45 (66 kg/ha), Urea (109 kg/ha); establishment (10 days): N 19.78 + P 5.00 + K 9.95 kg/ha
top_dressing_2: Fertigation—flower initiation to first picking (30 days): N 60.09 + P 7.49 + K 19.8 kg/ha; harvesting stage (45 days): N 60.00 + P 5.00 + K 40.1 kg/ha; total dose: N 200 + P 100 + K 100 kg/ha; fertigation inputs: Urea 351 kg/ha, 13-0-45 199 kg/ha, 12-61-0 25 kg/ha, 19:19:19 53 kg/ha
micronutrients: 19:19:19 + micronutrient grade at establishment (26.81 kg/ha) and harvest (26.31 kg/ha); ZnSO4 0.5% foliar if Zn deficiency; neem cake 100 kg/ha as pre-plant soil health amendment
variety_tips: Varieties: Sugar Baby, Arka Manik (25–30 t/ha in 120 days); hybrids: Arka Jyoti, Sonna, Suvarnima (80–90 t/ha); preferred: Mithila, Suganthi, Kiran, Simran, Vishal; sow November–December; spacing 0.9 m between hills with 2 seedlings per hill

soil_type: Well-drained loamy to clay loam soils; pH 6.0–7.5; alluvial soils of Indo-Gangetic plains ideal; avoid waterlogged and sandy soils; silt loam with 6.8 pH optimal; organic matter ≥1% preferred
watering_guideline: Irrigated timely sown: 5–6 irrigations; critical stages: CRI (20–21 DAS), tillering (40–45 DAS), jointing (60–65 DAS), booting (75–80 DAS), flowering (90–95 DAS), grain filling (105–110 DAS); water 3.0 cm at CRI, 4.5 cm at booting, 5.5 cm at flowering; rainfed: 250–350 mm total
basal_fertilizer: FYM 2–3 t/ha incorporated 5–6 weeks before sowing; 1/3 N + full P + full K as basal at sowing; NWPZ/NEPZ: N 150 + P 60 + K 40 kg/ha; NHZ: N 120 + P 60 + K 40 kg/ha (timely sown irrigated); rainfed: N 60 + P 30 + K 20 kg/ha applied entirely at sowing; ZnSO4 25 kg/ha in Zn-deficient soils
top_dressing_1: Remaining 2/3 N in two equal splits: first 1/3 at CRI irrigation (20–21 DAS), second 1/3 at second irrigation; light soils: 1/2 N at sowing, 1/4 at 1st irrigation, 1/4 at 2nd irrigation; use urea; late-sown irrigated: total 90:60:40 kg NPK/ha; foliar urea 3% spray at tillering if N-deficient
top_dressing_2: Final N (last 1/3) at second irrigation (tillering/jointing stage 40–45 DAS); MnSO4 2.5 kg in 500 L water 2–3 times near first irrigation; ZnSO4 25 kg/ha soil or 0.5% foliar spray for Zn deficiency; S 20 kg/ha as gypsum for S-deficient soils; no N after jointing stage
micronutrients: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha; MnSO4 foliar 2–3 times at 2.5 kg/500 L water; sulphur 3–5 kg/ha as S (via SO₄²⁻); iron foliar FeSO4 + citric acid if chlorosis; boron 1 kg/ha if deficient; balanced NPK prevents 35%+ soil micronutrient depletion seen in rice-wheat systems
variety_tips: NWPZ irrigated timely: HD 2967, WH 1105, PBW 621; NHZ: HS 507, VL 829 (rainfed); late sown: WH 1124, PBW 590; yield 4–6 t/ha irrigated timely sown, 3–4 t/ha NHZ; sow Nov 1–15 (NWPZ); seed rate 100 kg/ha timely, 125 kg/ha late or rainfed
